1.w: You, therefore, my child, be empowered in the grace that [is] in Christ Jesus.

2.w: And the things that you heard from me through many witnesses, entrust these to faithful men such as will be sufficient to teach others also.

3.w: Share in suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

4.w: No one serving as a soldier entangles himself in the affairs of life, so that he might please the one having enlisted him.

5.w: Now also, if anyone competes, he is not crowned unless he shall have competed lawfully.

6.w: It is necessary for the toiling farmer first to partake of the fruits.

7.w: Consider what I say, for the Lord will give you understanding in all things.

8.w: Remember Jesus Christ, having been raised out from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my gospel,

9.w: in which I suffer hardship even to chains as an evildoer. But the word of God has not been bound!

10.w: Because of this, I endure all things because of the chosen ones, so that they also may obtain the salvation that [is] in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.

11.w: Trustworthy [is] the word: For if we died together [with Him], we will also live together [with Him];

12.w: if we endure, we will also reign together [with Him]; if we will deny [Him], He also will deny us;

13.w: if we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He is not able to deny Himself.

14.w: Remind [them] these things, earnestly testifying before God not to fight about words, useful for nothing [but] to the subversion of those hearing.

15.w: Be diligent to present yourself approved to God, a workman unashamed, straightly cutting the word of truth.

16.w: But avoid profane, empty utterances, for they will advance to more ungodliness,

17.w: and their word will have pasture like gangrene, of whom are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

18.w: who missed the mark concerning the truth, saying the resurrection already to have happened; and they are overturning the faith of some.

19.w: Nevertheless, the firm foundation of God has stood, having this seal: “The Lord knows those being His,” and, “Let everyone naming the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

20.w: Now in a great house there are not only golden and silver vessels, but also wooden and earthen; and some indeed for honor, but some for dishonor.

21.w: Therefore if anyone shall have cleansed himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, having been sanctified, useful to the Master, having been prepared for every good work.

22.w: Now flee youthful lusts and pursue righteousness, faith, love, [and] peace, along with those calling on the Lord out of a pure heart.

23.w: And refuse foolish and ignorant controversies, knowing that they beget quarrels.

24.w: And it is necessary for a servant of the Lord not to quarrel, but to be kind toward all, able to teach, forbearing,

25.w: in gentleness disciplining those opposing, lest ever God may give them repentance unto a knowledge of the truth,

26.w: and they might come to their senses out of the snare of the devil, having been captured by him unto his will.
